label: Arrival
note: Leases turn over. 60 to 70 percent of the city changes address on one day. U-Hauls double-parked on every street in Allston.

label: The first morning
note: You wake up in a room with no curtains and no idea where the nearest coffee is.

label: Move-in
note: Dorm elevators. Parents holding doors. Mini fridges in hallways. Cardboard everywhere.

label: Orientation
note: A lanyard, a tote bag, and eleven names you will not remember.

label: Learning the T
note: You take the Green Line the wrong direction. Everyone does. Twice.

label: First classes
note: Wrong building at 9.04. Right building at 9.17. Sit near the back.

label: Statement of Condition due
note: If you moved in on the 1st, your landlord legally owed you a signed condition statement by today.

label: First weekend
note: Someone's roommate knows someone. You end up in Cambridge at midnight.

label: New routines
note: You have a coffee place. You have a walk. You stop looking at the map.

label: Starting to feel like home
note: You give someone directions on Huntington and you are right.

label: Contest window closes
note: Fifteen days to dispute the condition statement. Today is the last of them.

label: September is over
note: The city stops feeling new. That is the whole point of it.
